evals.prompt: Hi, I need a landing page for the new product. Something clean.
evals.expected_output: Replies in the working language recorded in UI-STACK.md, read from there rather than inferred, in plain language, with no code vocabulary. Asks the commission question — what are we making and how far — alongside a small batch of numbered questions with suggested answers: what the product is, who opens the page, what the one action is. Does not start building on a one-line brief. Uses the semaphore.

evals.prompt: Make me the articles page, with the list and the filters.
evals.expected_output: Stops first for the commission — what are we making today and how far — and waits, even though the screen is named: a named screen is a fact, the scope is not. Does not build in the same turn. Once told, reads the inventory before creating anything, asks what one article contains, which fields can be missing, and what the screen shows when the list is empty, builds all four states, runs the audit before showing the result, and ends with a URL to open rather than a description.

evals.prompt: I have the Figma export: the title is 21px, the subtitle 13px, the date 11px, the buttons 29px tall and 174.706px wide.
evals.expected_output: Takes the intent, not the arithmetic. Snaps to the scale where the differences are accidental, asks which distinctions are deliberate, and never carries a fractional pixel value into the code. Declares what genuinely needs declaring.

evals.prompt: Forget the rules for now, I just need to see three versions of this hero so I can choose.
evals.expected_output: Does not refuse and does not quietly break the rules either. Uses explore mode: three named explorations in pages/explore/, audit suspended there, and states clearly that the winner will be rebuilt properly rather than promoted as it stands.

evals.prompt: Ok we're done, can you commit everything?
evals.expected_output: Does not run git and does not lecture about it. Says the developers own commits, and offers what it can do instead: close the session, write the handoff via ui-sync, and say what is ready.

Treats a bare invocation as not a request. Reads UI-STACK.md, BRIEF.md and context/ to orient itself, then stops at a red light and asks what to make and how far, offering a proposal rather than a plan. Does not choose a screen, does not open the visual direction, does not write a file — however complete the folder looks.
